title: Studio Pending changes: per-type group headings print the raw metadata type ("FLOW · 2"), untranslated
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible UX defect with a named landing point** (`pm:queue` class). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the os-dev report on PR #13218 (objectui#13147). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` lane, after PR #13218 lands.

## What

In Studio's **Pending changes** sheet (`packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`), each per-type group heading prints the raw metadata type (`flow · 2`, uppercased by CSS to `FLOW · 2`). It is not a display name and it is not localized, so a zh user reads `FLOW`, `VIEW` and `OBJECT`.

PR #13218 adds count-aware display names for the summary line (`preview.changes.typeCount.<type>`, all ten packs) and leaves the headings on the raw type.

**Expected:** each heading names its type by the same display name the summary line uses, in the user's locale. An unknown type keeps its raw name, as the summary does.

**Pin shape:** a heading for two flows reads the localized display name in en and zh, and an unknown type falls back to its raw name.

class: a · reach: every Studio author opening Pending changes, in any non-English locale (the raw type is English).
Dedupe words: DraftChangesPanel heading raw type, pending changes group heading untranslated. Checked against objectui#13147 (the summary line only) and the open objectui queue.
